decisions.Kwic: 塵塵剎剎，曾現威光。物物頭頭，全彰正眼。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the unlabeled continuation of Ying'an Tanhua's imperial-birthday hall addresses says that every dust and every land has displayed majestic radiance and every thing fully manifests the true eye.

decisions.Kwic: 遂拈袈裟角，云：大眾！人人有分，須是頂門眼開始得。喝一喝，下座。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Zhenjing Kewen, who lifts a corner of his robe, tells the assembly that everyone has a share but must open the crown eye, gives one shout, and leaves the seat.

decisions.Kwic: 說不盡底、祖師提不起處，對眾八字打開去也。遂舉拂子，云：大眾還見麼？擊禪床，云：還見麼？見處透脫，聞處精明，一念返本還源，即具頂門三眼，萬里更

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): in the continuation of Yuanwu Keqin's imperial-commission address at Zhaojue, Yuanwu raises the fly-whisk, asks whether the assembly sees, strikes the Chan seat, and asks again.

decisions.Kwic: 入此門來，莫存知解。知解既不生，如王寶劍

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Mi'an Xianjie as opening an imperial-commission hall address by warning entrants not to retain conceptual understanding.

decisions.Kwic: 座問答罷，乃拈拂子召大眾曰：還見麼？手中拂子層層為諸人放百種寶光。復擊禪床曰：還聞麼？座下猊臺句句為諸人演一乘了義。諸人若向者裏悟得，則曠大劫

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Foyin Qing, who raises the fly-whisk after the exchange, asks whether the assembly sees, strikes the Chan seat, and asks whether it hears.

decisions.Kwic: 拍膝，云：劍去久矣，切忌刻舟。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): in the continuation of Yanxi Guangwen's awakening-day hall address, Yanxi slaps his knee and says the sword has long gone and one must never carve the boat.

decisions.Kwic: 四十九年播土揚塵，三百餘會納盡敗闕。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Zhantang Shen, who says that forty-nine years and more than three hundred assemblies took in every exposed failure.

decisions.Kwic: 如賓主相見，便有言論往來，或應物現形，或全體作用，或把機權喜怒，或現半身，或乘獅子，或乘象王。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): in Linji Yixuan's instruction on discerning guest and host, Linji says that when guest and host meet there is verbal exchange, responsive manifestation toward things, whole-body function, and displays of authority.

decisions.Kwic: 第一句薦得，和泥合水；第二句薦得，無繩自縛；第三句薦得，四稜著地。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): in the address introduced under Shishuang Chuyuan, Chuyuan contrasts Bao Ying's three phrases with his own Daowu formulation: realizing the first phrase mixes mud and water.

decisions.Kwic: 一隻水泄不通，緇素難辨；一隻大地全開，十方通暢；一隻高低一顧，萬類齊瞻。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Fushan Fayuan, who maps three eyes onto one that is watertight, one that opens the whole earth, and one that surveys high and low.

decisions.Kwic: 談玄說妙，譬如畫餅充饑；入聖超凡，大似飛蛾赴火。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Kaixian Ying, who opens his hall address by saying that a painted cake does not satisfy hunger and a drawn person is intolerant of seeing ugliness.

decisions.Kwic: 示眾，舉德山和尚因僧問：從上諸聖以何法示人？山云：我宗無語句，亦無一法與人。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): inside a case raised by a later speaker, Deshan Xuanjian is the exact quoted speaker who answers that his lineage has no words or phrases and truly has no Dharma to give people.

decisions.Kwic: 一人高高山頂立，一人深深海底行，各自隨方而來，同會九重城裏。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Huayan Jue, who opens his hall address with the paired lines about standing on the solitary summit and walking on the deepest sea floor.

decisions.Kwic: 更問如何自納敗闕？良久，高聲召大眾，眾舉首，師曰：歸堂喫茶。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Baohua Xian, who says that raising one atom embraces the great earth and that a single exposed failure conceals the whole body.

decisions.Kwic: 你諸人休向者裏立地瞌睡

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the expanded context explicitly heads the address as Guifeng Guang's; Guifeng Guang tells the assembly that lifting their feet and setting them down is already wrong and standing on the spot is still a mistake.

decisions.Kwic: 尋言逐句，求覓解會，千差萬別，廣設問難

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Yunmen Wenyan, who says that the old worthies could not help opening their cloth bags and that such words still require the listeners to understand them for themselves.

decisions.Kwic: 而今天下老和尚多是師承學解，露布葛藤，印板上打來，模子裏脫出。當人若是明去，何不一切臨時？

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): a later speaker explicitly quotes Yunmen Wenyan as saying that present-day old monks all set up mechanisms and devices and strike from a printing block.

decisions.Kwic: 句作麼生道？蒲團時倚無他事，永日寥寥謝太平。結夏，小參。明當結制，今夜小參，舉一兩則古人機緣與諸人商量，非惟截斷葛藤，要

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the target address is an unlabeled continuation within the explicitly headed sequence of Gulin Mao's summer-retreat small addresses; Gulin Mao says that the retreat will be established the next day and gives the present night's small address.

decisions.Kwic: 逢佛殺佛、逢祖殺祖、逢羅漢殺羅漢。真淨老人自謂臨濟正傳黃龍的子，七出八沒，得大自由。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the target New Year's Eve small address remains in the unlabeled continuation of Gulin Mao's explicitly headed sequence; Gulin Mao says to kill Buddha on meeting Buddha and kill an ancestor on meeting an ancestor before appraising Zhenjing and Zhaozhou.

decisions.Kwic: 教外別傳，不立文字，單提直截，究本明宗

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Huqiu Shaolong, who says that lifting the mallet and raising the fly-whisk amount to taking up the matter alone and cutting it off directly.

decisions.Kwic: 坐斷要津，不通凡聖

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the Jiangshan installation address is an unlabeled continuation in the explicitly headed run of Yuanwu Keqin's installation addresses; Yuanwu says that a single phrase cuts through the billion-world universe and sits atop the tongues of everyone in the realm.

decisions.Kwic: 坐斷毗盧頂，不稟釋迦文。

Decision.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Yuanwu Keqin's imperially commanded departure for Yunju; Yuanwu says that sitting astride the Buddha hall and cutting off the realm's tongues cannot yet be called the matter of a patch-robed monk.
